In the Metal Gear Solid series, Solid Snake and Liquid Snake are indeed twin brothers - they are both clones created from Big Boss's DNA as part of the Les Enfants Terribles project. Liquid Snake is the main antagonist of the first Metal Gear Solid game and is explicitly identified as Solid Snake's twin brother throughout the game's plot.
